title: World leaders return to UN amid wars in Middle East and Ukraine
gist: World leaders gather at a UN General Assembly described as stuck in 'open-ended crisis' amid US funding cuts, with agendas centered on the Middle East war (which is driving global inflation and threatening Bab el-Mandeb shipping), Ukraine and the Black Sea food/energy blockade, and AI risk, where Guterres calls for common guardrails while Trump dismisses AI risks as a 'hoax'.

insights.claim: Richard Gowan of the International Crisis Group says the UN is no longer in freefall but stuck in an open-ended crisis, trapped 'in a trauma center for the foreseeable future'.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor
insights.so_what: Expect multilateral institutions to remain weak brokers; geopolitical risk resolution will run through bilateral deals.
insights.quote: we would no longer say that the UN is in freefall, but we would say that it's stuck in an open-ended crisis
insights.locator: More than a year into Trump's second term

insights.claim: The US avoided losing its UN General Assembly vote by paying $725 million toward the regular budget, but still owes more than a billion dollars and keeps demanding cuts and reforms.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor
insights.so_what: Chronic US arrears constrain UN operations, including humanitarian and peacekeeping capacity.
insights.locator: The US avoided losing its vote

insights.claim: Xi Jinping is skipping the UN in favor of one-on-one talks with Trump in Washington, fueling debate about the UN's relevance.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor
insights.so_what: The Trump-Xi bilateral is the higher-signal event for trade and tech markets this week.

insights.claim: Secretary-General Antonio Guterres's term ends at the end of 2026 with no clear frontrunner to replace him.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor
insights.so_what: Leadership transition adds uncertainty to UN priorities including AI governance.

insights.claim: Several AI industry leaders recently called for a coordinated slowdown of AI development, warning it could soon self-improve and escape human control.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor
insights.so_what: Industry calls for a slowdown raise regulatory-risk tail for AI developers and compute suppliers.

insights.claim: Guterres calls for countries at the AI frontier to set common guardrails to avoid a race to the bottom that could lead to a global disaster, while Trump dismisses AI risks as a 'hoax' and says China would benefit from doubts about AI development.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor
insights.so_what: US opposition makes binding global AI regulation unlikely near term, favoring continued rapid US AI buildout.
insights.quote: common guardrails in order to avoid this race to the bottom that could lead one day to a gigantic disaster at the global level.

insights.claim: The US-Israeli war on Iran continues to drive global inflation, and Houthi gains threaten shipping in the Bab el-Mandeb Strait and could further spike energy prices.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor
insights.so_what: Energy-driven inflation persists; keep inflation hedges and watch Red Sea shipping for price spikes.

insights.claim: Guterres says a military solution to the Yemen problem is very difficult and past interventions show how complicated successful intervention is, with the UN envoy pushing talks.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor
insights.so_what: Low odds of a decisive military fix in Yemen implies prolonged Red Sea risk.
insights.quote: It's very difficult to have a military solution for that problem
insights.locator: "It's very difficult to have a military

insights.claim: Peace talks remain stalled as Iran and the US exchange strikes and Trump threatens major escalation.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor
insights.so_what: Escalation risk remains skewed upward; maintain geopolitical hedges.

insights.claim: Guterres says the effective Black Sea blockade is creating enormous problems that compound the Middle East crisis, and calls for safe passage of Ukrainian and Russian food, fertilizer and energy exports.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor
insights.so_what: Dual chokepoint stress (Black Sea plus Gulf/Red Sea) supports grain, fertilizer and energy prices.
insights.quote: The effective blockade existing in the Black Sea is creating enormous problems that add to the problems generated by the Middle East crisis

insights.claim: Zelenskiy is expected to use the UN to shore up Ukraine's position ahead of another tough winter, while the Security Council remains blocked by Russia's veto.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor
insights.so_what: No UN path to ending the war; winter energy stress in Europe remains a risk.

insights.claim: Trump has appeared frustrated at failing to broker an end to the Ukraine war and spoke with Putin earlier this month.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor
insights.so_what: Any Trump-Putin breakthrough would be a major catalyst for European assets and energy.
insights.locator: Trump has at times appeared frustrated
